title: Code and supporting data for Beyond Paper Counts: Measuring Representation, Entry, and Persistence at ICML and NeurIPS, 2018–2024
description: Current GitHub supporting materials for Beyond Paper Counts: original analysis code and inputs, plus additional country comparisons, aggregate diagnostics, provenance and current figure utilities. The original analysis is archived as Zenodo version 1.0.2 (10.5281/zenodo.23175869); the later additions are not part of that deposit and do not involve new outcome-model fits. Missing work-level OpenAlex inputs and unrecorded SPECTER2 revisions limit upstream reconstruction. Code is MIT; numeric model-input and calibration exports are CC0 1.0; upstream data retain their terms. No new archive version is asserted here; assign the actual version when making a future deposit. See README and docs/RELEASE.md.
